env GO111MODULE=off

go help build
stdout '-lto mode'

! go build -lto=full .
stderr 'go: unsupported -lto mode "full"'

! go build -lto=thin -buildmode=archive .
stderr 'go: -lto requires gc, buildmode=exe or pie, and no sanitizers or shared linking'

go build -n -a -lto=thin crypto/internal/fips140/sha256
stderr 'compile .* -p crypto/internal/fips140/sha256 .* -llvm-lto=thin'

env GOOS=windows
env GOARCH=amd64
! go build -lto=thin .
stderr 'go: -lto=thin is not supported on windows/amd64'

-- main.go --
package main
func main() {}
